description: Pew Pew is a fast airplane arcade game where the plane fires automatically while the player dodges danger, collects power-ups, destroys enemy waves, and survives increasingly difficult bosses.
intro: Because shooting is automatic, the useful skill is movement. The guide focuses on safe lanes, power-up collection, wave positioning, and keeping enough screen space to react to bosses.
guideTitle: Pew Pew Power-Up, Wave, and Boss Survival Guide
guideIntro: Damage comes automatically; survival does not. Smooth movement and early positioning are more reliable than chasing every enemy or pickup.
steps: Use WASD, arrow keys, or the mouse to make small controlled movements around incoming attacks.
Stay near an open escape lane instead of drifting into a corner during dense waves.
Collect power-ups when the route is safe, but do not cross a dangerous pattern for one pickup.
Move before tougher enemies crowd the screen so automatic fire has time to clear them.
During boss fights, learn the attack rhythm first and deal damage while following the safest gap.
